title: Mutation Buffs
blurb: Every mutation, its positive and negative effects, and the serum that grants it. A-Z.

lines: Item: Adrenal Reaction Serum
Vendor: Purchasable from the MODUS Pharmacy in the Whitespring Bunker, or crafted at a Chemistry Station with the recipe.
Note: A serum grants the mutation with none of its negative effects for one hour.
Fresh: Take radiation damage and the game rolls a random mutation from the pool. Starched Genes prevents new mutations, so unequip it before farming rads.
Note: A mutation gained this way carries its negative effects unless you also hold a serum or the Class Freak perk.
